title: Riftwalker
wikitext:
'''Riftwalkers''' are practitioners of '''riftwalking''', an ancient and sacred [[draenei]] magical art that allows them to tear open gateways through the [[Twisting Nether]].<ref name="Learn Of My Past">{{Neutral}} [52] [[Learn Of My Past]]</ref> When the [[orcish Horde]] ravaged the world of [[Draenor]], the draenei of the [[Tribe of Sanv]] opened a rift to the world of [[Azeroth]] to save themselves and [[Lost Ones|another tribe]], finding a new home in the [[Harborage]] and the [[Fallow Sanctuary]]. Meanwhile, the draenei of the [[Moro'gai tribe]] also ventured to Azeroth, finding a new home in the [[Moonwhisper Coast]].

Riftwalking requires a large amount of energy, and [[draenethyst]] is often used as a substitute for power by less experienced riftwalkers.<ref name="Learn Of My Past" /> Riftwalkers use canes infused with echoes of power as implements to channel their riftwalking.<ref>{{Neutral}} [54D] [[The Riftwalker's Cane]]</ref>

As riftwalking is taxing on the body and mind due to being exposed to the currents of the Twisting Nether, the draenei have developed recipes to combat the side effects of prolonged riftwalking and accelerate a riftwalker's mental recovery.<ref>{{Neutral}} [52] [[Rift Fatigue: Body]]</ref><ref>{{Neutral}} [52] [[Rift Fatigue: Mind]]</ref>

Interrupting a riftwalker is in most cases a death sentence, as the riftwalker is thrown through the Twisting Nether when their focus is interrupted.<ref name="Learn Of My Past" />
